name: OTHERSKIN: Live Another Life Experience Club
description: OTHERSKIN sells day-length BCI-recorded life experiences from consenting donors across all tiers — a Spire executive's morning routine in a sky-penthouse, a Shelf courier's adrenaline-soaked delivery run, a retired Axiom middle manager's slow Tuesday. The experience is delivered in full sensory fidelity: the donor's physical sensations, ambient emotions, and unscripted reactions preserved in a proprietary neural format called a 'skin.' Premium skins from high-tier donors are priced as luxury goods; Shelf-sourced skins have become unexpectedly popular among Tier 4 clients seeking 'authenticity tourism.'
story_hooks: A character buys a premium Spire executive skin and discovers, embedded in the recorded day, evidence of a deliberate cover-up of a mass casualty event in a Tier 1 district.
A Shelf courier discovers their own life is being sold as a skin without their knowledge or payment — and the buyer list includes people who have been following their real-world routes.
An OTHERSKIN skin begins updating after purchase, as if the donor is still recording — but the donor died six weeks ago.
